verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing describes automating recurring fixes, automated remediation across endpoints with monitoring policies, and the Tia agent building new automations. That points to background automations that run without a user present. However, the evidence is only marketing-level, with no documentation of how users set up, schedule, or trigger these automations. Remote script execution on its own reads as a one-off action, not a recurring background job. Missing for 10: documentation of how automations are configured, scheduling and trigger details, evidence that automations run unattended on a recurring basis, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
